figurative_meaning_en: to waste; to squander or ruin
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সব অর্থ জলে ফেলা হয়েছে ব্যবসায়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: All his money was thrown down the drain in that business.
note: Idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on resource conservation, often used in contexts of loss or futility.
